opening.text: My hand shakes, and I first noticed it in my left hand a year ago. Recently I've had trouble with tasks that need steadiness, like reading. My wife says my memory has been getting worse, and my voice has become soft. I take amlodipine for my blood pressure. I drink 1 to 2 beers every night, and I used to smoke cigars.
